<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:local="using:PingYi.App" x:Class="PingYi.App.ModePickerWindow" Classes="workspace" Title="{DynamicResource Ui.Text.7116a6da8a30}" Width="700" Height="700" MinWidth="540" MinHeight="480" WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner" Icon="avares://PingYi.App/Assets/pingyi-v2-icon.png">
  <Window.Styles>
    <StyleInclude Source="avares://PingYi.App/Styles/Workspace.axaml"/>
    <Style Selector="ListBoxItem">
      <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
      <Setter Property="Padding" Value="16,12"/>
      <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,8"/>
      <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="12"/>
      <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
      <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}"/>
      <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundBrush}"/>
    </Style>
    <Style Selector="ListBoxItem:selected">
      <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BrandBrush}"/>
      <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BrandSoftBrush}"/>
    </Style>
  </Window.Styles>
  <Grid Margin="24" RowDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto" RowSpacing="16">
    <StackPanel Spacing="6">
      <TextBlock Text="{DynamicResource Ui.Text.7116a6da8a30}" Classes="workspace-title"/>
      <TextBlock Text="{DynamicResource Ui.Text.c2ec0bca09ab}" Classes="workspace-help"/>
    </StackPanel>
    <ListBox Grid.Row="1" x:Name="ModesList" Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" SelectionChanged="ModesList_OnSelectionChanged" AutomationProperties.Name="{DynamicResource Ui.Text.e1d715452e7f}" ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
      <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
        <DataTemplate x:DataType="local:ModeChoice">
          <StackPanel Spacing="5">
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="16" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Method}" FontSize="12" Foreground="{DynamicResource BrandBrush}" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Purpose}" Classes="workspace-help"/>
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Requirements}" Classes="workspace-help" FontSize="12"/>
          </StackPanel>
        </DataTemplate>
      </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
    </ListBox>
    <Grid Grid.Row="2" ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto,Auto" ColumnSpacing="10">
      <TextBlock Text="{DynamicResource Ui.Text.cf15f4b8b319}" Classes="workspace-help" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
      <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="{DynamicResource Ui.Text.2cd0f3be8738}" Click="Cancel_OnClick"/>
      <Button Grid.Column="2" x:Name="ApplyModeButton" Classes="primary" Content="{DynamicResource Ui.Text.487c5545cad9}" IsDefault="True" Click="Apply_OnClick"/>
    </Grid>
  </Grid>
</Window>
